zone_count.title: Number of zones
zone_count.description: How many irrigation zones do you want to configure? In the next step you'll only fill in the ones you actually use - leave the rest blank.

data.zone_count: Number of irrigation zones (in the next step you'll only fill in the ones you use)

location.title: Garden location
location.description: Defaults to your home (from Home Assistant's general configuration) - drag the pin if the garden is elsewhere. Used to calculate ET0 and sunrise.

data.auto_mode_enabled: Enable fully automatic watering (no manual approval)
data.start_mode: Mode for determining watering start time (relative to sunrise or a fixed clock time)
data.start_offset_min: Offset in minutes (used for 'before/after sunrise' modes)
data.start_clock_time: Fixed start time (used for the 'at a set time' modes)
data.auto_trigger_buffer_min: Safety buffer when calculating the trigger time (min)

data.zone_transition_delay_sec: Delay between closing one zone and opening the next (s)
data.valve_verify_timeout_sec: How long to wait for valve open/close confirmation (s)
data.main_flow_sensor: Main flow meter - cumulative liters (default for zones without their own)
data.main_flow_rate_sensor: Main flow meter - INSTANTANEOUS flow, e.g. L/min (default for zones without their own)
data.flow_rate_zero_threshold: Below this flow value, we consider there to be no water

data.pressure_sensor: ABSOLUTE/station pressure sensor in hPa (NOT 'relative' or VPD - the name matters, not the device class/unit)
data.rain_sensor: Rainfall - cumulative counter / total rain (mm, NEVER resets)

data.rain_detected_sensor: Fast rain detector (binary_sensor OR a plain mm/h sensor, e.g. sensor.your_weather_station_rain_rate) - speeds up reaction during watering
data.rain_rate_threshold_mmh: Rain intensity threshold (mm/h) for a numeric rain sensor
data.rain_pause_threshold_mm: Rain threshold that triggers a pause DURING watering (mm)
data.rain_pause_check_interval_min: How often to check rainfall while running/paused (min)
data.rain_pause_max_wait_min: How long to wait before giving up on confirming the rain has stopped and resuming ANYWAY, with a reduced target (min) - the integration NEVER abandons watering purely because of how long it rains, only when the rain itself has already covered that zone's need
data.rain_stop_confirmation_min: How many minutes of UNINTERRUPTED absence of rain are required before the integration considers the rain over and resumes watering mid-run (0 = resume after the first clean check, as before). Protects against frequently opening/closing the valve when rain falls in waves rather than continuously. If it rains longer than "Max wait time" (above), the integration resumes anyway (with a target reduced by the measured rainfall), instead of waiting forever for confirmation of quiet

data.wind_skip_threshold_ms: Above this wind speed, wind-sensitive zones (sprinklers) are skipped
data.frost_threshold_c: Below this temperature, ALL watering is skipped (frost risk)
data.dynamic_mad_enabled: Dynamic MAD adjustment per FAO-56 (initial value - controlled afterwards by the "Dynamic MAD adjustment" switch entity)
data.rain_priority_over_heat: Forecasted rain takes priority over forced heatwave watering

data.weather_entity: Weather service entity (weather.*) - the integration will fetch the rain forecast itself
data.weather_forecast_hours: How many upcoming forecast hours to sum (mm)
data.weather_forecast_interval_min: How often to poll the weather service for the forecast (min, independent of other sensors)
data.rain_skip_threshold_mm: Rain threshold for SKIPPING watering entirely (mm)
data.rain_forecast_lookback_min: Rain forecast max-memory window - how far back (min)

finish.title: Finish & save
finish.description: All settings from the categories you visited have been kept. Click Submit to save the integration (you can go back to the menu and fill in more categories at any point before saving).

data.zone1_name: Zone name (e.g. Lawn, Pots) - leave blank for the default
data.zone1_switch_entity: Zone valve / switch (switch or valve) - blank = zone inactive
data.zone1_flow_sensor: Zone flow meter (optional, more accurate measurement of water used)
data.zone1_plants: Plants in this zone (multiple selection allowed)
data.zone1_max_runtime_min: Maximum watering time for this zone (min) - safety limit
data.zone1_timer_entity: Watchdog: zone timer on the controller (number.*, optional)
data.zone1_kc_override: Manual Kc calibration (blank = calculate from selected plants, e.g. 0.65)
data.zone1_mad_override: Manual MAD threshold calibration (blank = calculate from selected plants, e.g. 0.45)
data.zone1_germination_depth_override_mm: Manual dose override - germination (mm), blank = from plant catalog
data.zone1_young_depth_override_mm: Manual dose override - young plants (mm), blank = from plant catalog
data.zone1_flow_rate_sensor: Instantaneous flow sensor for this zone (optional, blank = use the main one)
data.zone1_min_days_between_watering: Minimum interval between waterings of this zone (days, 0 = no limit) - encourages roots to grow deeper
data.zone1_wind_sensitive: Wind-sensitive zone (sprinklers) - skipped in strong wind
data.zone1_root_depth_override_plant: Root depth from a selected plant (optional - the list only shows plants already saved for this zone, sorted by Kc; blank = automatic maximum across all selected plants)
data.zone1_drip_line_length_m: Drip line length (m) - only for the "Drip line" type, ignored for others
data.zone1_drip_spacing_cm: Emitter spacing along the line (cm) - only for the "Drip line" type
data.zone1_drip_emitter_lph: Single emitter flow rate (L/h) - for "Drip line" or "Individual emitters"
data.zone1_drip_count: Number of emitters (units) - only for the "Individual emitters" type
data.zone1_learn_rate_from_flow: Learn the application rate from the flow meter (requires a connected flow meter)
data.zone1_auto_calc_rate: Automatically calculate the application rate from the irrigation type - this affects ONLY THE SUGGESTION IN THIS FORM (what's pre-filled in the "Application rate" field below when you open the configuration); it does NOT control the actual rate used for watering, nor the value shown on the zone's sensor in Home Assistant - that depends solely on what you save in the "Application rate" field below, and on the "Learn from flow meter" switch below. Applies to ALL types (sprinklers/micro-sprinklers get a table value, drip line/individual emitters get a value calculated from their parameters). If the integration has already learned something from the flow meter, the suggestion shows the LEARNED value instead of the formula. The suggestion only appears after saving and RE-ENTERING "Configure" for this zone - not immediately on first entry. If disabled, the manually entered value in the "Application rate" field below stays unchanged forever - in this form only.
data.zone1_adjust_runtime_from_flow: Automatically adjust the watering duration based on measured consumption (requires a flow meter) - the timer/watchdog duration is then ALWAYS the zone's configured maximum, so it never gets in the way of extending the run. NOTE: with this enabled, the total sequence time may not finish exactly at sunrise or at the scheduled time, if the "start before sunrise" mode is selected - delivering the right amount of water takes priority over sticking to the schedule to the minute. When disabled: the timer/watchdog duration is exactly the calculated time for the zone, with no live extension or shortening.
data.zone1_force_heat_deficit_pct: Deficit threshold to force (% of MAD threshold)

data.pressure_sensor: ABSOLUTE/station pressure sensor in hPa (NOT 'relative' or VPD - the name matters, not the device class/unit)
data.rain_sensor: Rainfall - cumulative counter / total rain (mm, NEVER resets)

data.rain_detected_sensor: Fast rain detector (binary_sensor OR a plain mm/h sensor, e.g. sensor.your_weather_station_rain_rate) - speeds up reaction during watering
data.rain_rate_threshold_mmh: Rain intensity threshold (mm/h) for a numeric rain sensor
data.rain_pause_threshold_mm: Rain threshold that triggers a pause DURING watering (mm)
data.rain_pause_check_interval_min: How often to check rainfall while running/paused (min)
data.rain_pause_max_wait_min: How long to wait before giving up on confirming the rain has stopped and resuming ANYWAY, with a reduced target (min) - the integration NEVER abandons watering purely because of how long it rains, only when the rain itself has already covered that zone's need
data.rain_stop_confirmation_min: How many minutes of UNINTERRUPTED absence of rain are required before the integration considers the rain over and resumes watering mid-run (0 = resume after the first clean check, as before). Protects against frequently opening/closing the valve when rain falls in waves rather than continuously. If it rains longer than "Max wait time" (above), the integration resumes anyway (with a target reduced by the measured rainfall), instead of waiting forever for confirmation of quiet

data.frost_threshold_c: Below this temperature, ALL watering is skipped (frost risk)
data.dynamic_mad_enabled: Dynamic MAD adjustment per FAO-56 (initial value - controlled afterwards by the "Dynamic MAD adjustment" switch entity)
data.rain_priority_over_heat: Forecasted rain takes priority over forced heatwave watering

data.weather_entity: Weather service entity (weather.*) - the integration will fetch the rain forecast itself
data.weather_forecast_hours: How many upcoming forecast hours to sum (mm)
data.weather_forecast_interval_min: How often to poll the weather service for the forecast (min, independent of other sensors)
data.rain_skip_threshold_mm: Rain threshold for SKIPPING watering entirely (mm)

valve_open_failed.title: Valve did not confirm opening
valve_open_failed.description: Zone {garden_irrigation_zone_name}, entity {entity_id}, did not confirm opening within the allotted time. Check the power, connectivity, and controller status. This zone was skipped; the rest of the garden continues normally.

valve_close_failed.title: Valve did not confirm closing - check manually!
valve_close_failed.description: Zone {garden_irrigation_zone_name}, entity {entity_id}, did not confirm closing within the allotted time. This may mean the valve is still physically open. Check it manually as soon as possible. The rest of the watering sequence was stopped for safety.

missing_zone_entity.title: Missing zone entity
missing_zone_entity.description: Zone {garden_irrigation_zone_name} is configured with entity {entity_id}, which does not exist in Home Assistant. Check that the device is connected, or fix the integration configuration.

missing_temp_sensor.title: Missing temperature sensor
missing_temp_sensor.description: No temperature sensor is configured - without it, ET0 (and therefore the entire water balance) cannot be calculated, so the integration will never suggest watering. Add a temperature sensor in the integration's configuration (Weather station step).

runtime_too_short.title: Zone watering time limit too low
runtime_too_short.description: Zone {garden_irrigation_zone_name}: the maximum watering time is set to {configured_min} min, but fully refilling the root zone from empty (e.g. after a vacation or a series of days skipped due to rain) requires about {required_min} min. With the current setting, the integration will never manage to deliver the full amount. Consider raising the limit in the zone configuration (the 'Maximum watering time' field) to at least {required_min} min, with a small margin.
